component.name: Hello Neighbor
component.summary: A stealth horror game remake in pure Rust and Macroquad

description.p: A minimal, ultra-lightweight 3D first-person remake of Hello Neighbor written in pure Rust and Macroquad. Sneak into your neighbor's house, locate the key, and escape without being caught.

ul.li: First-person movement with crouch, sprint, and jump mechanics
Smart reactive AI with line-of-sight detection and suspicious states
Distraction mechanics: throw objects to divert the neighbor
High-performance procedural 3D visuals running at under 15MB of RAM

description.p: Initial Flatpak release with full game loop and procedural sound effects.
